image_description: A traffic light suspended from a horizontal wire against a blue sky with clouds. The top of the frame is obscured by green tree branches and leaves. The traffic light housing is black with three vertical signal lenses. The bottom lens is illuminated green, while the top two (red and amber) are unlit. A thick black cable runs horizontally across the middle of the image.
